content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Target:** § 2.2 (p0013) — "Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term."
- **Why it fails:** This binds *us* to exclusive dealing for the entire term, with no product-category narrowing, no 12-month sunset, and no automatic exit on service-level or delivery failure — i.e., the rule's walk-away scenario, not merely short of preferred.
- **Internal conflict:** It contradicts § 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and § 12.3 (Vendor expressly acknowledges Customer has made *no* exclusivity commitment), which also supports deletion as the cleanest fix.
- **Redline:** Delete § 2.2 (validated ok:true), reaching the preferred position, with the category/12-month/performance-exit fallback offered in the comment.
- **Not flagged:** The "non-exclusive" license grant in § 13.1 and exclusive-jurisdiction/exclusive-remedy references in §§ 19.4, 21.4, 28.2, 30.2 are unrelated uses of the word and do not restrict our sourcing freedom.
